title: 6.9 Can I swim here?
unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
goal: Ask for permission with Can I … here? and answer Yes, you can. / No, you can't. (Can I swim here? No, you can't.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.9 Finding a Safe Way: A1 understands can and cannot in a visible situation; A1+ 6.9 asks for permission. The new items are the question Can I … here? and its short answers Yes, you can. / No, you can't., with the short form can't (You can't swim here.). Each No photo shows the person beside a round red sign whose crossed-out picture is the thing they want to do (swim, ride a bike, take photos); the Yes photos show Diego at an empty park bench and Ana riding her bike in A1+ 2.2's park, with no sign.
prerequisite: A1 6.9 can and cannot, here; A1+ 1 swim and ride; A1+ 2.2-2.3 bike and camera.
speaking_outcome: Say can't with a long a (KANT) and stress it; say Can I as kən-AI. Do not require native-like speed.
